title: Weather Today and Tomorrow
text:
Today is sunny. The sky is blue and the sun is hot. Tom wears a hat and a T-shirt. He goes to the park with his dog.

Tomorrow it will be cloudy and cold. Maybe it will rain in the afternoon. Tom takes his red umbrella. He likes rainy days too.

questions.text: What does Tom take with him tomorrow?
How does Tom probably feel about the weather today?
options: He is happy to be outside.
He is afraid of the sun.
He is sad about the sky.

questions.text: Why will Tom probably need his umbrella tomorrow?
options: It might rain in the afternoon.
The sun will be very hot.
He wants to play in the snow.

vocabulary.definition: with many clouds in the sky
an object you hold above your head to stay dry in the rain
the part of the day between noon and evening

paragraph_translations: Dzisiaj jest słonecznie. Niebo jest niebieskie, a słońce jest gorące. Tom zakłada czapkę i koszulkę. Idzie do parku ze swoim psem.
Jutro będzie pochmurno i zimno. Może po południu będzie padać. Tom bierze swój czerwony parasol. On też lubi deszczowe dni.
